triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '39. More early rescale VALU is not automatically better latency hiding' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 39. More early rescale VALU is not automatically better latency hiding

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL Flash Attention on MI308X (gfx942) -- 39. More early rescale VALU is not automatically better latency hiding

payload.attempted: Once VMEM wait is delayed across a rescale window, expand the window: rescale all output accumulator chunks early so more `v_pk_mul_f32` instructions can overlap the outstanding V loads.
payload.lesson: Latency hiding is constrained by the actual dependency window, not by the number of independent VALU instructions you can manufacture. Add early rescale only when ATT shows it lands in a stall window and the benchmark confirms the gain.

established_fact.mechanism: The extra rescale work increases VALU pressure and changes scheduling. Only the required rescale work fit usefully into the delayed-VMEM window; adding more independent VALU did not create more useful overlap.

payload.observed: `EARLY_RESCALE_ALL=1` measured `3.494454 ms / 59.927313 TFLOPS`, slower than the final default `3.479213 ms / 60.189822 TFLOPS`.
payload.root_cause: The extra rescale work increases VALU pressure and changes scheduling. Only the required rescale work fit usefully into the delayed-VMEM window; adding more independent VALU did not create more useful overlap.
